name: op_apply_le
doc: 算子范数的定义性不等式：`‖T x‖ ≤ ‖T‖ ‖x‖`。
stmt: theorem op_apply_le (T : E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E) : ‖T x‖ ≤ ‖T‖ * ‖x‖
proof: T.le_opNorm x

name: op_norm_nonneg
doc: 算子范数非负。
stmt: theorem op_norm_nonneg (T : E →L[ℝ] F) : 0 ≤ ‖T‖
proof: norm_nonneg T

name: op_norm_zero
doc: 零算子的算子范数为 0。
stmt: theorem op_norm_zero : ‖(0 : E →L[ℝ] F)‖ = 0
proof: ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_zero

name: op_norm_id_le
doc: 恒等算子的算子范数不超过 1。
stmt: theorem op_norm_id_le : ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E‖ ≤ 1
proof: ContinuousLinearMap.norm_id_le

name: op_norm_id
doc: `E` 非平凡时恒等算子的算子范数恰为 1。
stmt: theorem op_norm_id [Nontrivial E] : ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E‖ = 1
proof: ContinuousLinearMap.norm_id

name: op_norm_smul_le
doc: 实标量齐次（用 `NormedSpace` 实例的 `norm_smul_le`）。
stmt: theorem op_norm_smul_le (c : ℝ) (T : E →L[ℝ] F) : ‖c • T‖ ≤ ‖c‖ * ‖T‖
proof: norm_smul_le c T

name: op_norm_comp_le
doc: **次乘性**：`‖T.comp S‖ ≤ ‖T‖ ‖S‖`（自行从 `opNorm_le_bound` 证明）。
stmt:
theorem op_norm_comp_le (S : E →L[ℝ] F) (T : F →L[ℝ] G) :
    ‖T.comp S‖ ≤ ‖T‖ * ‖S‖
proof:
by
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound (T.comp S) (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg T) (norm_nonneg S))
    (fun x => ?_)
  calc ‖(T.comp S) x‖ = ‖T (S x)‖ := rfl
    _ ≤ ‖T‖ * ‖S x‖ := T.le_opNorm (S x)
    _ ≤ ‖T‖ * (‖S‖ * ‖x‖) := by
        have h := S.le_opNorm x
        have hT : 0 ≤ ‖T‖ := norm_nonneg T
        nlinarith
    _ = (‖T‖ * ‖S‖) * ‖x‖ := by ring

name: op_norm_comp_apply_le
doc: 复合在向量上的界：`‖T (S x)‖ ≤ ‖T‖ ‖S‖ ‖x‖`。
stmt:
theorem op_norm_comp_apply_le (S : E →L[ℝ] F) (T : F →L[ℝ] G) (x : E) :
    ‖T (S x)‖ ≤ ‖T‖ * ‖S‖ * ‖x‖
proof:
by
  calc ‖T (S x)‖ ≤ ‖T‖ * ‖S x‖ := T.le_opNorm (S x)
    _ ≤ ‖T‖ * (‖S‖ * ‖x‖) := by
        have h := S.le_opNorm x
        have hT : 0 ≤ ‖T‖ := norm_nonneg T
        nlinarith
    _ = ‖T‖ * ‖S‖ * ‖x‖ := by ring

name: op_norm_pow_le
stmt:
theorem op_norm_pow_le (T : E →L[ℝ] E) : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖T ^ n‖ ≤ ‖T‖ ^ n
  | 0 => by
      rw [pow_zero, pow_zero]
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.norm_id_le
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]
      calc ‖T ^ n * T‖ = ‖(T ^ n).comp T‖
proof:
rfl
        _ ≤ ‖T ^ n‖ * ‖T‖ := op_norm_comp_le T (T ^ n)
        _ ≤ ‖T‖ ^ n * ‖T‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (op_norm_pow_le T n) (norm_nonneg T)
        _ = ‖T‖ ^ (n + 1) := by ring

name: op_norm_pow_apply_le
doc: **深度 n 的信号放大上界**：`‖T^n x‖ ≤ ‖T‖^n ‖x‖`。
stmt:
theorem op_norm_pow_apply_le (T : E →L[ℝ] E) (n : ℕ) (x : E) :
    ‖(T ^ n) x‖ ≤ ‖T‖ ^ n * ‖x‖
proof:
by
  calc ‖(T ^ n) x‖ ≤ ‖T ^ n‖ * ‖x‖ := (T ^ n).le_opNorm x
    _ ≤ ‖T‖ ^ n * ‖x‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (op_norm_pow_le T n) (norm_nonneg x)

name: op_norm_pow_apply_le_of_le
doc: 若 `‖T‖ ≤ c`，则深度 n 的放大不超过 `c^n`。
stmt:
theorem op_norm_pow_apply_le_of_le {T : E →L[ℝ] E} {c : ℝ} (_hc : 0 ≤ c) (h : ‖T‖ ≤ c)
    (n : ℕ) (x : E) : ‖(T ^ n) x‖ ≤ c ^ n * ‖x‖
proof:
by
  calc ‖(T ^ n) x‖ ≤ ‖T‖ ^ n * ‖x‖ := op_norm_pow_apply_le T n x
    _ ≤ c ^ n * ‖x‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg T) h n)
        (norm_nonneg x)

name: op_dist_le
doc: 线性算子是全局 `‖T‖`-Lipschitz：`‖T x - T y‖ ≤ ‖T‖ ‖x - y‖`。
stmt: theorem op_dist_le (T : E →L[ℝ] F) (x y : E) : ‖T x - T y‖ ≤ ‖T‖ * ‖x - y‖
proof:
by
  rw [← map_sub]
  exact T.le_opNorm (x - y)

name: op_dist_pow_le
doc: 深层距离界：`‖T^n x - T^n y‖ ≤ ‖T‖^n ‖x - y‖`。
stmt:
theorem op_dist_pow_le (T : E →L[ℝ] E) (n : ℕ) (x y : E) :
    ‖(T ^ n) x - (T ^ n) y‖ ≤ ‖T‖ ^ n * ‖x - y‖
proof:
by
  rw [← map_sub]
  exact op_norm_pow_apply_le T n (x - y)

end Lattice

name: outer
doc: 秩-1 外积：`(outer u v) i j = u i * v j`。
stmt: def outer (u : m → ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) : m → n → ℝ
proof: fun i j => u i * v j

name: vecNorm
doc: 向量欧氏范数：`sqrt (∑ i, u i ^ 2)`。
stmt: def vecNorm {m : Type*} [Fintype m] (u : m → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: Real.sqrt (∑ i, u i ^ 2)

name: vecNorm_nonneg
stmt: theorem vecNorm_nonneg {m : Type*} [Fintype m] (u : m → ℝ) : 0 ≤ vecNorm u
proof: Real.sqrt_nonneg _

name: vecNorm_sq
stmt:
theorem vecNorm_sq {m : Type*} [Fintype m] (u : m → ℝ) :
    vecNorm u ^ 2 = ∑ i, u i ^ 2
proof: Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg (u i)))

name: frobSq_outer
doc: 外积的 Frobenius 范数平方 = 两个向量平方范数之积。
stmt:
theorem frobSq_outer (u : m → ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) :
    frobSq (outer u v) = (∑ i, u i ^ 2) * (∑ j, v j ^ 2)
proof:
by
  unfold frobSq outer
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

name: outer_rank_one
doc: **秩-1 外积的 Frobenius 范数 = 两向量范数之积**。
stmt:
theorem outer_rank_one (u : m → ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) :
    frob (outer u v) = vecNorm u * vecNorm v
proof:
by
  unfold frob vecNorm
  rw [frobSq_outer,
    Real.sqrt_mul (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg (u i)))]

name: sum_swap_three
doc: 有限和的三重换序：`∑ i ∑ j ∑ k g i j k = ∑ k ∑ i ∑ j g i j k`。
stmt:
theorem sum_swap_three {q : ℕ} (g : m → n → Fin q → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ k, g i j k) = ∑ k, ∑ i, ∑ j, g i j k
proof:
by
  calc ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ k, g i j k
      = ∑ i, ∑ k, ∑ j, g i j k := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = ∑ k, ∑ i, ∑ j, g i j k := by rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: row_sum_sq_le
doc: Cauchy–Schwarz（全 1 权重）：`(∑ k, a k)^2 ≤ r * ∑ k, a k^2`。
stmt:
theorem row_sum_sq_le {q : ℕ} (a : Fin q → ℝ) :
    (∑ k, a k) ^ 2 ≤ (q : ℝ) * ∑ k, a k ^ 2
proof:
by
  have h := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin q)) a (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
  have hcard : (∑ _k : Fin q, (1 : ℝ) ^ 2) = (q : ℝ) := by simp
  simpa [hcard, one_mul, mul_comm] using h

name: lowRankSum
doc: 低秩参数化：`(∑_{k<r} outer (u k) (v k)) i j = ∑ k, u k i * v k j`。
stmt: def lowRankSum {r : ℕ} (u : Fin r → m → ℝ) (v : Fin r → n → ℝ) : m → n → ℝ
proof: fun i j => ∑ k, u k i * v k j

name: low_rank_reparam
doc:
**低秩参数化的 Frobenius 范数界**：
`frobSq (∑_{k<r} outer (u k) (v k)) ≤ r * ∑ k (vecNorm (u k) * vecNorm (v k))^2`。
stmt:
theorem low_rank_reparam {r : ℕ} (u : Fin r → m → ℝ) (v : Fin r → n → ℝ) :
    frobSq (lowRankSum u v) ≤ (r : ℝ) * ∑ k, (vecNorm (u k) * vecNorm (v k)) ^ 2
proof:
by
  have hrow : ∀ i j, (∑ k, u k i * v k j) ^ 2 ≤ (r : ℝ) * ∑ k, (u k i * v k j) ^ 2 :=
    fun i j => row_sum_sq_le (fun k => u k i * v k j)
  calc frobSq (lowRankSum u v)
      = ∑ i, ∑ j, (∑ k, u k i * v k j) ^ 2 := rfl
    _ ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, (r : ℝ) * ∑ k, (u k i * v k j) ^ 2 :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => hrow i j))
    _ = (r : ℝ) * ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ k, (u k i * v k j) ^ 2 := by
        simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = (r : ℝ) * ∑ k, frobSq (outer (u k) (v k)) := by
        congr 1
        exact sum_swap_three (fun i j k => (u k i * v k j) ^ 2)
    _ = (r : ℝ) * ∑ k, (vecNorm (u k) * vecNorm (v k)) ^ 2 := by
        congr 1
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k _
        calc frobSq (outer (u k) (v k))
            = (∑ i, u k i ^ 2) * (∑ j, v k j ^ 2) := frobSq_outer (u k) (v k)
          _ = (vecNorm (u k) * vecNorm (v k)) ^ 2 := by
              rw [mul_pow, vecNorm_sq, vecNorm_sq]

name: factorized_bound
doc: 逐项矩阵和上界（矩阵因子分解形式）：`∑∑ (∑_k u i k * v k j)^2 ≤ r * ∑∑∑ ...`。
stmt:
theorem factorized_bound {r : ℕ} (u : m → Fin r → ℝ) (v : Fin r → n → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, (∑ k, u i k * v k j) ^ 2)
      ≤ (r : ℝ) * ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ k, (u i k * v k j) ^ 2
proof:
by
  calc ∑ i, ∑ j, (∑ k, u i k * v k j) ^ 2
      ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, (r : ℝ) * ∑ k, (u i k * v k j) ^ 2 :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum
          (fun j _ => row_sum_sq_le (fun k => u i k * v k j)))
    _ = (r : ℝ) * ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ k, (u i k * v k j) ^ 2 := by
        simp only [Finset.mul_sum]

name: frob_add_le
doc: **Frobenius 范数三角不等式**：`frob (A + B) ≤ frob A + frob B`。
stmt: theorem frob_add_le (A B : m → n → ℝ) : frob (A + B) ≤ frob A + frob B
proof:
by
  have hA := frobSq_nonneg A
  have hB := frobSq_nonneg B
  have hAB : (∑ i, ∑ j, A i j * B i j) ≤ frob A * frob B := by
    have h1 : (∑ i, ∑ j, A i j * B i j) ^ 2 ≤ (frob A * frob B) ^ 2 := by
      have hsq := frobSq_inner_sq_le A B
      have hff : frobSq A * frobSq B = (frob A * frob B) ^ 2 := by
        show frobSq A * frobSq B
          = (Real.sqrt (frobSq A) * Real.sqrt (frobSq B)) ^ 2
        rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hA, Real.sq_sqrt hB]
      linarith
    have h2 : |∑ i, ∑ j, A i j * B i j| ≤ frob A * frob B := by
      have habs := sq_le_sq.mp h1
      rwa [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (frob_nonneg A) (frob_nonneg B))] at habs
    exact le_trans (le_abs_self _) h2
  have hexp : frobSq (A + B)
      = frobSq A + 2 * (∑ i, ∑ j, A i j * B i j) + frobSq B := by
    have h1 : ∀ i, (∑ j, (A i j + B i j) ^ 2)
        = (∑ j, A i j ^ 2) + 2 * (∑ j, A i j * B i j) + (∑ j, B i j ^ 2) := by
      intro i
      have hpt : ∀ j, (A i j + B i j) ^ 2
          = A i j ^ 2 + 2 * (A i j * B i j) + B i j ^ 2 := fun j => by ring
      simp only [hpt]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    unfold frobSq
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, h1]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  have hsq : frobSq (A + B) ≤ (frob A + frob B) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hexp]
    have hfA : frobSq A = (frob A) ^ 2 := (Real.sq_sqrt hA).symm
    have hfB : frobSq B = (frob B) ^ 2 := (Real.sq_sqrt hB).symm
    rw [hfA, hfB]
    nlinarith [hAB,

name: low_rank_error_budget
doc:
**低秩近似的误差-预算**：若低秩部分 `L` 的 Frobenius 范数不超过预算 `B`，
则整体 `L + E` 的 Frobenius 范数不超过 `B + frob E`。
stmt:
theorem low_rank_error_budget {L Epart : m → n → ℝ} {B : ℝ} (hL : frob L ≤ B) :
    frob (L + Epart) ≤ B + frob Epart
proof:
le_trans (frob_add_le L Epart) (add_le_add_right hL (frob Epart))

end Lattice
